name: 洪荒世界（修复版）
english_name: Honghuang World — Fixed Edition (World of Primordial Chaos)
english_description: Part of the "Nitan" (NT) mudlib lineage, sharing a byte-identical master codebase with this collection's hhsj (the original Honghuang World) and nitan170911. New characters begin in the "Nitan Registration Hall" and must complete an elaborate, multi-step "birth" ritual — choosing a race, gender, and temperament, then allocating attribute points in the "Valley of Life" — before truly entering the world.
